_correction_13_sep_2026: Arun flagged Monday 14-Sep-2026 as a market holiday; this calendar said it was a trading day. The file had been built in May from TENTATIVE dates and was wrong in eleven places. It listed six days that TRADED (2026-02-19, 2026-03-04, 2026-05-06, 2026-08-15 which is a Saturday anyway, 2026-08-27, and future 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-04) and was missing nine closures (2026-01-15, 2026-03-03, 2026-03-26, 2026-05-28, 2026-06-26, 2026-09-14, 2026-10-20, 2026-11-10, 2026-11-24). Every past date in this corrected list was confirmed against market_data.db: no NIFTYBEES or RELIANCE daily bar on the closed days, a normal bar on the days the old file wrongly closed. Three of the future holidays (20-Oct, 10-Nov, 24-Nov) are Tuesdays, the NIFTY weekly expiry day, so the old file would have mis-dated those expiries.
